own_solution.law: Bateman parent-daughter decay: A_D(t) = A_P0 * lambda_D/(lambda_D - lambda_P) * (exp(-lambda_P t) - exp(-lambda_D t)); lambda = ln2/T_half
assumptions: activities refer to the column contents

notes: lambda_D/(lambda_D-lambda_P) = (1/6)/(1/6-1/66) = 1.1; 2^(-24/66)=0.777203; 2^(-4)=0.0625; A_D = 4000*1.1*0.714703 = 3144.7 Bq. With total parent 5300 Bq: 5300*0.786173 = 4166.7 Bq. Sentences T5569 and T3269 say 'a further small amount' with no number, while their apparent partners (T3A18, TCB75) state 1300 Bq; if these are intended as minimal-pair variants they differ in the number.
